Blood leaks out, and sticky cells called platelets rush to the graze.
The platelets clump together and spin a net of threads that traps the blood.
The trapped blood dries out and hardens into a crusty brown scab.
Under the scab, new skin grows, until one day the scab falls off by itself.

answer: One windy morning, Ari found a glass bottle bobbing in Gull Bay, with a note inside.
The note said, 'Help! I'm stuck on Gull Rock. Please bring chips.'
Ari rowed her little boat out to Gull Rock as fast as she could.
When she got there, a very grumpy pelican was sitting on the rock, holding a pen in its beak.
Ari shared her chips and rowed the pelican back to shore, and it never wrote another note.

She wrapped it gently in her scarf and carried it down the ladder to the crew's hut.
In the hut, she checked the bird all over and found that one wing was badly bruised.
For a week, she kept the rosella in a warm box and fed it seeds and slices of apple.

Wren carried it back to Tower Two and watched it fly off to join its noisy flock.

A pearl begins when a tiny intruder, such as a speck of grit, slips inside an oyster's shell.
Because the intruder irritates the oyster's soft flesh, the oyster coats it in a smooth, shiny substance called nacre.
Layer after layer of nacre builds up over months and years, until the intruder is completely sealed inside.
Eventually, these layers harden into a gleaming pearl, and the more layers there are, the more valuable it becomes.
That is why a pearl that grew inside an oyster for ten years is worth far more than one that grew for one.

While mixing, he misread the faded card and tipped in two cups of salt instead of two cups of sugar.
When the judges took their first bite of the salty cake, their faces crumpled, and the head judge spat hers into a napkin.
Seeing their faces, Mo tasted the cake himself, realised his mistake instantly and raced back to the kitchen with twenty minutes left.
With seconds to spare, he slid a lopsided, three-layer sponge onto the judges' table, still steaming from the oven.
It wasn't pretty, but it tasted wonderful, and Mo walked away with a ribbon for 'Best Comeback'.
